description.value: Tea at the Empress is a world-renowned afternoon tea served in the grand Lobby Lounge of the Fairmont Empress, a Victoria landmark continuously operating since 1908. The experience centres on a proprietary Empress Blend tea and an elaborate spread of finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with house-made clotted cream, and handcrafted pastries. It has hosted royalty, celebrities, and dignitaries, and remains one of the most storied culinary traditions in British Columbia.
